note: Dated, named sources only. Values are entered into each company's assumption ledger by `python -m app.research.setup_cli market`. Edit a value here (or enter one with assumption_cli) and re-apply: the old record is superseded, never overwritten.

risk_free_rate.source: Trading Economics: India 10-year government bond yield 7.312% (13 Nov 2026) less Damodaran's India default spread 1.87% (Baa3, January 2026 update)
risk_free_rate.rationale: Rupee risk-free rate = benchmark 10-year government yield 7.31% minus the sovereign default spread 1.87%, because the government yield is not default-free and the 7.08% equity risk premium already includes India's country risk premium (otherwise country risk is counted twice). The 1.87% spread is Damodaran's published figure; subtracting it is the standard adjustment but is not stated on his page. 7.31% corroborated by Kotak Neo (7.39% on 29 Oct 2026).

equity_risk_premium.source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Country default spreads and risk premiums, January 2026 update: India total equity risk premium (Moody's Baa3)
equity_risk_premium.rationale: Total equity risk premium for India = mature-market premium 4.23% + country risk premium 2.85%, as published in the January 2026 update.

tax_rate.source: Income-tax Act 1961, section 115BAA (domestic company, concessional regime): 22% basic rate + 10% surcharge + 4% health and education cess
tax_rate.rationale: Statutory tax rate on a domestic company under section 115BAA: 22% x 1.10 x 1.04 = 25.168%, applied to operating profit in the forecast. Statutory, so it does not carry a loss-year or one-off effective rate into the forecast.

beta.source: Damodaran (NYU Stern), Betas by sector - India (betaIndia.xls), data as of January 2026
